home.tagline: Authentic content for brands that want to stand out.

about.intro:
Hi, I'm Perla — a UGC creator focused on beauty, fashion, and lifestyle.

I work with brands to create authentic, scroll-stopping content that feels real and relatable.

cards.title: Reels & short-form video
cards.description: Scroll-stopping reels and TikToks that showcase your product in an authentic way. Scripted or freestyle, tailored to your platform and audience.

cards.title: Static content & carousels
cards.description: Feed posts, carousels, and static ads that match your brand look and feel. Perfect for launches, campaigns, and evergreen content.

cards.title: Unboxings & first impressions
cards.description: Genuine unboxing and first-use content that builds trust and excitement. Ideal for product drops and PR packages.

cards.title: Custom packages
cards.description: Bundles built around your goals: multiple deliverables, usage rights, and timelines that work for your campaign.
